strategy_description: 5-min bars, CNC overnight hold 2-3 days. Range defined from first 30-60 min of NSE session. Breakout from that range enters long (initially). TimedExit for N-day time-stop, PriceExit for stop-loss/target.

marcus.edge_thesis: NSE opening range dynamics reflect real institutional order flow. First 30-min range represents price discovery; breakout signals resolved directional bias. 2-3 day CNC hold captures institutional program follow-through, distinct from Donchian daily-bar breakout mechanism.
marcus.signal_frequency_estimate: 40-80 trades/year per instrument (6-year window: 240-480 trades). Well above 30-trade signal audit gate and 35/year threshold.
marcus.historical_parallel: Donchian failed on daily-bar DSR-corrected Sharpe gate. ORB is structurally different: intraday session structure vs multi-week daily lookback. Different mechanism, different competition set.
marcus.pipeline_risk: Walk-forward gate is most likely structural barrier — IS-to-OOS Sharpe degradation expected in choppy regimes (COVID 2020, rate shock 2022). Correlation risk manageable if ORB concentrates on instruments outside MACD survivors.
marcus.sizing: Vol-target 10% annualized, 20-bar rolling std dev of daily log returns, fraction capped at 1.0. Per-instrument notional derived post-sweep.
marcus.kill_switch: Derived per accepted kill-switch methodology after bootstrap: SharpeP5 as rolling Sharpe threshold, 1.5x MaxDD, 2x MaxDDDuration.
marcus.verdict_rationale: Edge mechanistically sound, infrastructure complete, frequency adequate, structurally distinct from killed daily-bar breakout strategies.
